name: Ethiopia on Mars

frame.town: at the island centre; local -z runs up the street

materials.note: the level's own terracotta ground (mars-world.js groundTex, the loop's colour) laid over the town; the trough's tiles step aside beneath it
weathered boards, stelae, the carved Aksum-style spires with their own haze (spireFog), glass domes: the level's own materials

note: The Tex Lexington western (mars/index.html), poured into the trough. The trough brings the player and every way of moving; the can brings the place, its people, its water and its storm.
